thread:
Tara: Quick heads-up — PR #4821 is the migration guide for the new routing policy. Needs a docs review + merge before the v0.9.2 docs cutoff (Thu 11:59pm PT). CI preview currently failing link-check.

Josh: I can take a look today. Is the content gated behind a feature flag or landing immediately?

Tara: It's behind feature flag `routing.multiregion_v2`. We need the doc in the versioned site (v0.9) and the unversioned site. Ideally merged before cutoff so the QA team can validate the redirect rules.

Lenka: Re: link-check — I saw one broken internal anchor to `/dev/explainers/kv-cache`. Quick fix should be to change to `/dev/runtime/kv-cache` (short patch).

Eva: Adding: make sure the code snippet for SDK usage uses the new `client.route()` call. Old example still shows `client.send()` which will confuse customers.

Prashant: I can do the quick link/SDK fix and push a patch to the same branch. Who's approving after that? @Josh?

Josh: Yep, I'll review after Prashant pushes.

Amanda: docs-ci-bot reran the preview: build succeeded but link-check flaked with a 504 to the internal docs host — seems transient. /cc @release-captain for cutoff timing. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

release-captain: We have a hard cutoff Thu 11:59pm PT to include in the v0.9.2 release candidate. If merges land after that they go to v0.9.3. Can we get PR merged by 6pm PT Thu to allow staging verification?

Tara: 6pm PT is fine. Prashant — can you push the patch by EOD tomorrow?

Prashant: Yes, will push by EOD tomorrow and mention when CI finishes. I'll also add a small note in the frontmatter about `version: v0.9` and the unversioned redirect.

Lenka: After Prashant pushes, docs-ci-bot please run `link-check` and the preview. If it fails, add the `ci/retry` label and ping in this thread.

docs-ci-bot: Noted. You can trigger a manual rerun with `gh workflow run docs-preview.yml -f pr=4821` or click "Re-run jobs" in Actions.

Josh: Plan: I'll do content review + approve once CI is green. If anything blocks at 5pm Thu, call it out here and we'll escalate to release-captain for a possible hold.

Tara: Also note: this doc touches the migration guide consumers follow. QA will need the docs-preview URL for the e2e tests. Amanda, can you confirm test harness picks up the preview URL automatically?

Amanda: Yes, QA harness pulls from the latest successful preview for the PR number. Just remind me when PR is merged and I'll queue the smoke runs.

Eva: Small checklist to avoid follow-ups: update SDK snippet, fix link, add frontmatter `version: v0.9`, confirm FF name in the doc, and ensure preview passes link-check.

Prashant: Will update checklist in the PR description as well.

Tara: Thanks team. I'll post a final "ready to merge" here once Josh approves and CI is green. :rocket:

Josh: Approved pending CI — will add the review when green.

docs-ci-bot: CI passed: docs-preview succeeded and link-check cleared. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/4821 

Tara: All set — merging now. If anything odd shows up in staging, we revert and re-open the PR.

Amanda: Kicking off QA smoke run now. ETA 30m.

release-captain: Thanks everyone — included in v0.9.2 release candidate cut. :tada:
